High-level: Acme is currently at Contract Review (legal redline in flight), target close this month, ARR $480k ARR 1st-year. Risk profile: timeboxed procurement, pending MSA acceptance, and PO timing.

Please send short bullets for each item below (I need to consolidate into a single note to Finance):
- Current stage + last customer touch date
- R/Y/G flag (why)
- Required action owner + ETA to de-risk (if any)
- Any dependency on Legal/Finance/product that blocks signature

I attached the latest heatmap and the MSA candidate (acme_MSA_v3.pdf). If you have a one-line script to nudge Procurement or a firm commit window from the buyer, include it.

Thanks — Rishi

Rishi — updates below on ACME and two peers (short bullets as requested).

ACME (ACME-4321) — Stage: Contract Review (legal)
- Last touch: 2027-05-13 (demo + procurement prep)
- Flag: Yellow — MSA redlines are moderate, buyer verbally committed to month-end close but procurement wants two clarifications on data retention and private deployment SLA windows.
- Action / Owner: I’m owning MSA redline resolution w/ legal; sending proposed compromise language by COB Monday (2027-05-17).
- Blockers: Procurement requested a shorter data retention clause and a SOC2 audit excerpt. Legal said they can accommodate the retention wording with 2 clauses; we can share SOC2 extract tomorrow.

Zenitrix (companion late-stage) — Stage: Final Demo
- Flag: Green — exec sponsor confirmed readiness to move once PO issued; low legal friction.

Pulsewave — Stage: Commercial Review
- Flag: Red — competing PoC and internal budget freeze; needs exec outreach.

Adding context from Finance needs and my recommendation: 

- Finance is asking whether Acme will slip >30 days or if we have a realistic close window. For modeling, they need the worst-case PO date and a best-case PO date.
- Recommend we propose a 2-week expedited review: Marissa to send redline with two compromise clauses + SOC2 extract; I will offer a short, non-binding target date of 2027-05-26 (best) and 2027-06-10 (worst). Finance wants that in writing.
- If Procurement requests an extended negotiation, we should propose a short conditional credit that preserves economics but delays revenue recognition — Sean, can you confirm finance is open to a limited 30-day escrow/credit?

If agreed, I’ll draft the note to finance and include the two-date window plus RYG flag.

Naomi

Quick — finance OK with a very narrow bridge/escrow option but needs: 
1) documented customer sign-off on target PO date window
2) legal confirmation the credit is time-limited (30 days) and contingent on PO receipt
3) clear ARR treatment (we’ll defer recognition until PO is received).

I can draft the finance memo once you (Marissa) send the one-liner commitment window and Naomi confirms the RYG rationale. If ACME confirms best-case 2027-05-26, that keeps the model green; anything past 2027-06-10, we show a risked revenue entry.
